# grokhack-index

> Nightly index of the Grok/xAI integration surface (endpoints, models, features, env vars, SDK exports, packages, code snippets with commit-pinned URLs) across the forks listed in awesome-grokhack, with a static search UI and an inverted index.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [indexer/grokindex.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index/blob/main/indexer/grokindex.py): indexer
- [indexer/search.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index/blob/main/indexer/search.py): search
- [repos.json](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index/blob/main/repos.json): repo list

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/awesome-grokhack](https://github.com/Blockchains/awesome-grokhack): source repo list
- [Blockchains/grokhack-forge](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-forge): consumes parts to compose apps
- [Blockchains/grok-tools-chat](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-tools-chat): parts recorded in its PARTS.md
